async def act(page):
    # The user menu is already open (button expanded: True), so I don't need to click it again.
    # Click the 'Byte Blaze' link to go to the user/group profile.
    byte_blaze_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Byte Blaze")
    if await byte_blaze_link.count() > 0:
        await byte_blaze_link.click()
        await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)  # Wait for page to load
    else:
        # If 'Byte Blaze' link not found, try to find a 'Settings' link in the user menu.
        settings_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Settings")
        if await settings_link.count() > 0:
            await settings_link.click()
            await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
        else:
            # Fallback: look for any link with text containing 'profile'.
            profile_links = page.get_by_role("link").filter(has_text="profile")
            if await profile_links.count() > 0:
                await profile_links.first.click()
                await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
            else:
                print("No profile or settings link found.")
                return
    # Now on the user profile or settings page, look for 'Access Tokens' or 'RSS' link.
    access_tokens_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Access Tokens")
    if await access_tokens_link.count() == 0:
        access_tokens_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="RSS")
    if await access_tokens_link.count() > 0:
        await access_tokens_link.click()
        await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
    else:
        # If not found, try to find links with text containing 'token' or 'feed'.
        token_link = page.get_by_role("link").filter(has_text="token")
        if await token_link.count() == 0:
            token_link = page.get_by_role("link").filter(has_text="feed")
        if await token_link.count() > 0:
            await token_link.first.click()
            await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
        else:
            print("No access tokens or RSS link found.")
            return
    # On the access tokens page, look for the RSS feed token in a textbox or status element.
    token_element = page.get_by_role("textbox")
    if await token_element.count() == 0:
        token_element = page.get_by_role("status")
    if await token_element.count() > 0:
        # Get the token value without processing.
        token = await token_element.input_value() if await token_element.get_attribute("value") else await token_element.text_content()
        # Print the token as-is.
        print(token)
        return token
    else:
        print("No token element found.")
        return
